name: Full Recliner B
source: Cineplex booking-site seat map screenshot, Mon Nov 23 2026, 8:00 PM showing (VIP 19+, Full Recliner)
notes: The booking site does not show the hall number, so this room is named by its format. Seat numbers are not shown on the map: they count from the left of each row and may not match the numbers on a ticket. Row A has wheelchair spaces (left as gaps) with a companion seat next to each. AA is a front row of three pairs; the map leaves a one-row aisle between AA and A, which the 3D room does not show. Entrance is not known, so the default is used. Dimensions are estimates. A different hall from Full Recliner A, with the same layout except that the inner seat of the last pair in row C is not drawn.
